explanation: Faithfully states LeechLattice's bound h(N) ≪ N^{2/3}, where h(N) is the fewest colours of [1,N] such that every 4-term AP sees at least 3 colours. It is true but outdated: erdosproblems.com/160 reports Hunter's improvement h(N) ≪ N^{log 3/log 22 + o(1)} (≈ N^{0.355}), which could be added as a variant.
